stem: Which of the following best describes a hybrid procedure in the treatment of congenital heart disease?

options.text: The use of both echocardiography and fluoroscopy simultaneously
A procedure that combines catheter-based techniques with surgical intervention
Treating two different heart defects in one session
A procedure performed by both a paediatric and an adult cardiologist
A catheter-only procedure performed under general anaesthesia

explanation: Hybrid procedure means combining catheter-based techniques with surgical intervention, often to manage complex congenital heart disease.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because using both echocardiography and fluoroscopy is an imaging approach, not the defining feature of a hybrid procedure
optionExplanations.B: Correct because it combines catheter-based techniques with surgical intervention, which is the definition of a hybrid procedure
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because treating more than one defect in a single session does not by itself define a hybrid procedure
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a hybrid procedure refers to combining treatment modalities, not simply involving different specialists
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a catheter-only procedure is not hybrid; a hybrid procedure includes both catheter-based and surgical elements

source.hint: This approach bridges the gap between the operating room and the catheterization laboratory.
